traits.terminal_bud.note: Sargent's Manual (sargent-1922), Prosopis (p. 599), where Neltuma's species stood: 'Trees or shrubs, with branches without a terminal bud and armed with geminate supra-axillary persistent spines'.

traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Neltuma (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.72 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 61 records in 21 sources); trunks 0.73, branches 0.67. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Jepson eFlora's account of velvet mesquite, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flower radial, small; calyx shallowly bell-shaped; petals free, generally inconspicuous; stamens 10, exserted, free.

traits.flowering_position.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Prosopis chapter (read in full; the American mesquites were in Prosopis then): the flowers are borne in spike-like axillary racemes.
